scenarios.name: SP1 prompt bug fixes-01 Stage 1a prohibits hallucinated losses and hazards

steps.text: the template stage1a_system.j2 is loaded
the template text contains "Every loss must be traceable to either a risk card or a specific feature described in the use-case text"
the template text contains "Every hazard must reference a concrete component, data flow, or capability from the use-case description"

scenarios.name: SP1 prompt bug fixes-02 Stage 1b prohibits hallucinated tools and entry points

steps.text: the template stage1b_system.j2 is loaded
the template text contains "Every tool in tool_inventory must be explicitly mentioned or directly implied by the use-case description"
the template text contains "Every entry point must correspond to an actual interface described in the use case"

scenarios.name: SP1 prompt bug fixes-03 Stage 2 Call 3 defines coordination links

steps.text: the template stage2_call3_system.j2 is loaded
the template text contains "Coordination links capture dependencies between responsibilities"
the template text contains "share state, data, or control flow"
the template text contains "inter-controller coordination"
the template text contains "Two responsibilities sharing a process model part not connected by a control action"
the template text contains "One responsibility's feedback channel updates a PM part that another responsibility controls"
the template text contains "Two responsibilities need to agree on a shared resource"
the template text contains "An empty coordination_links list is acceptable only when no two responsibilities share state, data, or control flow"
